purpose: Decide whether moving from the qualified Swiss 200 m baseline to 100 m is scientifically justified and numerically stable. Passing the engineering-capacity gate alone is insufficient.

prerequisites.required_100m_hicar_commit: same as the qualified 200 m month source
prerequisites.required_forcing: identical REA-L valid times and variables at both resolutions
prerequisites.required_observations: identical SwissMetNet and OGD samples at both resolutions

paired_event_design.land_initialization: resolution-matched REA-L-derived land and snow state using the same valid time and semantics
paired_event_design.static_identity: each resolution uses one checksum-frozen static domain; the 100 m terrain filter and boundary-relaxation identity are frozen before execution

matched_scientific_comparison.sampling: Use the intersection of valid 100 m, 200 m, REA-L, SwissMetNet, and OGD samples. Scores from different samples cannot be compared.

catastrophic_non_degradation_relative_to.precipitation_interval_rmse_rule: 100 m RMSE <= max(1.25 * 200 m RMSE, 200 m RMSE + 0.5 kg m-2)
catastrophic_non_degradation_relative_to.rhiresd_precipitation_rmse_rule: 100 m RMSE <= max(1.25 * 200 m RMSE, 200 m RMSE + 0.5 kg m-2)

terrain_sensitive_skill_families.skill_definition: 1 - error_metric_100m / error_metric_200m on identical samples; lower error is better
terrain_sensitive_skill_families.interpretation: At least two terrain-sensitive families must improve in median, one improvement must be robust at 95 percent confidence, and no family may degrade by more than five percent.

required_checks: conservative aggregation of 100 m precipitation to the 200 m grid
area-weighted aggregation of 100 m surface fluxes to the 200 m grid
bilinear aggregation of 100 m thermodynamic and wind fields to the 200 m grid
slope, elevation, valley, ridge, land-cover, and boundary-distance stratification
two-gridpoint and four-gridpoint noise diagnostics for winds, precipitation, temperature, and surface fluxes
spatial_consistency.failure_condition: Any coherent grid-scale checkerboard, boundary imprint inside the active 10 km interior, or unphysical terrain-locked extreme without observational or process support is STOP_AND_REDESIGN.

authorization.interpretation: A pass authorizes only a separately planned 31-day 100 m month pilot. It does not authorize an annual or 20-year 100 m campaign.

requirements: Every 100 m segment, solver, compression, provenance, restart, water, energy, observation, and OGD report passes.
No unexplained post-spinup monotonic drift occurs in soil water, snow, canopy water, surface energy, or near-surface climate.
The paired 100 m versus 200 m scientific comparison repeats on the retained month with the same frozen skill rules.
Measured compute, forcing, restart, output, validation, and durable-storage costs fit an approved 100 m annual envelope.
follow_on_month_gate.interpretation: Only a passing 100 m annual cycle under predeclared application-quality and archive contracts may later authorize 100 m production.
